statutet.title: Statutes
statutet.paragraphOne: The statutes of Shoqata Studenti form the legal and organizational foundation of the association. They define the organization's structure, the responsibilities of its governing bodies, the rights and obligations of its members, and the principles on which the association's work is built. The statutes regulate decision-making processes, the organization of the General Assembly, the election of the board, financing, and the association's overall operation.
statutet.paragraphTwo: Shoqata Studenti operates according to the principles of transparency, equality, political independence, and protection of its members' personal data. The statutes also clearly define the association's purpose: creating an academic, cultural, and social platform for Albanian students in Zurich and promoting Albanian identity, language, and culture.

strukturaPage.title: Structure
strukturaPage.p1: The organisational structure of Shoqata Studenti is based on the principles set out in the association’s statutes. The highest decision-making body is the General Assembly, which consists of active members with voting rights. All active members have the right to vote and participate in the association’s key decision-making processes.
strukturaPage.p2: The board serves as the association’s executive body and is responsible for implementing General Assembly decisions, administering the association and organising its activities. There is no internal hierarchy within the board. Board members work collectively and according to the principle of shared responsibility. In this sense, membership institutionally stands above the board, since the board is elected and mandated by the members themselves.
funding: support from ETH Zurich (VSETH), the University of Zurich (VSUZH) and other academic or cultural institutions
income from activities and events organised by the association
strukturaPage.p3: In accordance with the association’s statutes, Shoqata Studenti has no commercial sponsors and may not accept or solicit monetary sponsorship from profit-making companies. This funding structure is intended to preserve the association’s independence, neutrality and institutional autonomy.

infoPage.title: Info
infoPage.p1: Shoqata Studenti is an active organisation officially recognised at ETH Zurich and the University of Zurich. It brings together Albanian students from different fields and backgrounds, creating an academic, social and cultural platform for the Albanian student community in Zurich. Through lectures, panels, trips, sports activities, and cultural and social events, the association aims to strengthen connections between students and promote Albanian identity, language, culture and academic engagement.
infoPage.p2: On the eve of the difficult years 1998–2001, the Albanian Student Association “Studenti” was founded. From the beginning, the association was created as a space for Albanian students at Zurich’s universities.
infoPage.p3: It was founded as a place where students could meet, exchange ideas, build community and represent their voice in academic and social life.
infoPage.p4: The association is part of VSETH, VSUZH and the Federation of Albanian Student Associations in Switzerland. Its work is based on transparency, equality, political independence and national engagement. Above all, Studenti remains a space where Albanian students can feel part of a shared community during their studies and beyond.

history.title: History
history.body:
Shoqata Studenti was founded in 2000–2001 by a small group of Albanian students in Zurich. According to accounts from founders such as Sami Kurteshi, Luljeta Aliu and Alban Nevzati, the reason for establishing the “Studenti” association was to formalise an Albanian student group that met regularly. According to Sami Kurteshi, the issue that especially prompted them to meet and organise together was discrimination against Albanians in Macedonia, a situation that escalated into open war in January 2001.

Today, more than 25 years later, Shoqata Studenti continues to be a hub for Albanian students in Zurich and is also the largest Albanian student organisation in Switzerland.

evente.sofraBody: An evening dedicated to our tradition of hospitality. Everyone brings a dish from home to share with others, creating a shared table of food, music, and dance. As our custom goes, we welcome you: "With bread, salt, and heart."

evente.ligjerataBody: Every semester we organise academic lectures to bring attention to topics that matter to us. These gatherings are a good opportunity to deepen our knowledge of different issues and to develop meaningful discussions together.

transnationale-demokratie.title: Transnational democracy
transnationale-demokratie.body:
Transnational Democracy: Political Participation Rights of the Albanian Diaspora

The panel explores how the Albanian diaspora can exert political influence beyond national borders and take part in democratic processes.
The event is organized in cooperation between Shoqata Studenti and the Centre for Legislation (Zentrum für Rechtsetzungslehre) at the University of Zurich, bringing together legal, political, and media perspectives on transnational democracy in the Albanian context.

Panelists:
Mentor Latifi | Adelina Gashi | Enver Robelli
Co-organizer: Prof. Dr. iur. Felix Uhlmann (UZH)
Moderation: Mërgim Gutaj (UZH)

kongresi-i-berlinit.title: Kongresi i Berlinit
kongresi-i-berlinit.body: During our trip to Berlin, Prof. Hasan Bello gave a lecture on the Congress of Berlin. It was the ideal opportunity to discuss this event, so essential to Albanian history, right where it took place, and to deepen our knowledge.

alumni.intro: Our Alumni program aims to keep strong ties between former students and the current Shoqata Studenti community. Through this network, members gain opportunities to exchange experiences, build connections, and support each other across generations.
alumni.dinner: Every year, a traditional alumni dinner is also organised as a meeting point and a way to reconnect with our community.

sport.intro: Shoqata Studenti organises weekly sports activities for students and its members. Meetings take place once a week in Oerlikon, Halle 8, alternating between volleyball and football.
sport.goal: The project aims to strengthen the social and community side of the association through sport and physical activity.

collaborations.intro: Shoqata Studenti regularly collaborates with Albanian professional organizations and networks in Switzerland, with the goal of building bridges between students and Albanian professionals from different fields.
collaborations.summary: These collaborations include events, discussions, networking, and joint academic and professional activities.

federata.heading: Federation of Albanian Student Associations in Switzerland
federata.intro: Shoqata Studenti is part of the Federation of Albanian Student Associations in Switzerland, a network that brings together eight Albanian student associations from different Swiss cities. The federation serves as a platform for coordination and collaboration among Albanian students at the national Swiss level.
federata.representation: Shoqata Studenti is represented in the federation through its delegates and participates in annual meetings, joint projects, and national-level student initiatives.
federata.activities: Within the federation, trips, events, and various collaborations are also organised among the participating associations.
